ui.text:
[Iron Junction story test]

Greenwater and Iron Junction are playable in this candidate; Red Hollow and the fair are not. It is a greybox: floors and labelled stand-ins. Travel there now?

[Iron Junction story test]

The Night Mail road is complete. You can go back: what was settled stays settled.

[Iron Junction story test]

Not yet. Deliver the marshal's dispatch to Sheriff Pritchard and hear him out first.

[Iron Junction story test]

Iron Junction could not be reached, so no arrival is recorded. Nothing else was changed. See the script log.

[Old Contrary]

The yardmaster has not given you the footplate. Speak to Augusta Lockridge at her desk.

[Old Contrary]

Nobody at the yard is giving out this run. The payroll and the fever medicine are aboard.

[Iron Junction story test]

Assignment accepted. Board the Night Mail.

[Scene]

The Night Mail leaves the yard for Sawtooth Cut. The eleven miles are not shown: you are set down on her footplate where she stops at the lanterns. No moving engine is simulated.

[Scene]

The Night Mail is standing in Sawtooth Cut. You walk the line back to her.

[Scene]

You walk the line out to Sawtooth Cut on foot. The train is not there, and no train is moved.

[Old Contrary]

There is nothing to do with her here.

[Regulator]

Nobody is at the regulator. It is a lever.

[Scene]

The run at the spread rail is shown as a staged scene: you are set down at the valley platform with what arrives. No moving engine, jump or damage is simulated.

[Scene]

Old Contrary backs out of the Cut to the yard with her cargo. Shown as a staged scene: you are set down on her footplate in the yard.

[Regulator]

The line through the Cut is clear. The payroll and the fever medicine are still aboard.
buttons: Take the train back to the yard

ui.text:
[Scene]

The Night Mail goes on through the Cut to the valley. Shown as a staged scene: you are set down at the valley platform.

[Scene]

The Night Mail goes back to the yard with her cargo. Shown as a staged scene: you are set down on her footplate in the yard.

[Iron Junction story test]

That could not be shown, so nothing is recorded. Use the same control again, or one where you now stand.

[Iron Junction story test]

That cannot be shown in this build: a piece of it is missing. Nothing is recorded. Report this to the tester.

[Iron Junction story test]

The Night Mail got through. The payroll and the fever medicine are at the valley platform; Old Contrary is damaged.

[Iron Junction story test]

The payroll and the fever medicine are at the valley platform.

[Iron Junction story test]

The train is back at Iron Junction with its cargo undelivered. The obstruction at Sawtooth Cut remains.

[Iron Junction story test]

The train is back at Iron Junction. The payroll and the fever medicine are locked in the yard, undelivered. The line through the Cut is clear.

[Iron Junction story test]

Preacher Dole is dead. The Black Rail have gone up the hill and the line is clear. The payroll and the fever medicine are still aboard.

[Offer]

Offer: 150 caps.

[Iron Junction story test]

No share was paid and no deal was made. See the script log.

[Iron Junction story test]

You accepted Dole's share: 150 caps. The payroll and the fever medicine were taken from the train. Billie Tupper was put off to walk home.

[Iron Junction story test]

You accepted Dole's share: 150 caps. The payroll and the fever medicine were taken from the train.

[Iron Junction story test]

The share is paid. The rest of the sale could not be shown, so it is not recorded yet. Use Dole, a control or the mail car again. Nothing is paid twice.

[Collection plate]

The plate is full of silver slugs. Each is stamped with a small square mark.

[Top drawer]

The inspector's stamp is in the drawer. The pad is still wet.

[Top drawer]

Nobody at the desk answers for the stamp.

[Iron Junction story test]

The stamp stays in the drawer, in use. Every car is still passed in the inspector's name, and suspect stock is still dispatched.

[Scene]

Lockridge goes through the entries and countersigns them in her own name. Shown as a staged scene; no night passes.

[Iron Junction story test]

Lockridge countersigned the reviewed entries in her own name. Suspect stock is held from dispatch.

[Iron Junction story test]

You took the inspector's stamp as evidence. It has not yet been delivered to Pritchard.

[Iron Junction story test]

The stamp could not be taken. Nothing is recorded and nothing else is decided about it. See the script log.

[Iron Junction story test]

That could not be done. Nothing is recorded.

[Top drawer]

The stamp is in the drawer, in use.

[Top drawer]

The stamp is in the drawer. Lockridge signs in her own name now.

[Top drawer]

The drawer is empty. You took the stamp.

[Hymnal]

You are carrying the hymnal from the tabernacle.

[Iron Junction]

Augusta Lockridge no longer dispatches trains from this yard.

[Iron Junction story test]

You accepted Dole's share. The payroll and medicine were taken from the train.

[Scene]

By this scene's clock it is the next morning. Billie Tupper has walked the eleven miles in and told the yardmaster what happened in the Cut. No game time passes.

[Scene]

You go back along the line to Iron Junction yard on foot. The train stays where it is.

[Road to Mercy]

Leave Iron Junction? The road is complete once you are back at Mercy Crossing.

[Road to Mercy]

The Night Mail is not settled. Leaving settles nothing; you can come back.

[Road to Mercy]

Leave Iron Junction?

[Iron Junction story test]

Night Mail road complete. Greenwater remains playable; Red Hollow and the fair are not. Sheriff Pritchard will hear what became of the Night Mail.

[Iron Junction story test]

You left Iron Junction with the Night Mail unsettled. The road is still open.

[Greybox]

You stepped off the greybox floor and were set back on it.

[Greybox: Iron Junction yard]

The rules are on the gate. The office desk, drawer and dispatch board are here; the board shows the yard's current status. The footplate stand-in is on the next part of this floor.

[Greybox: Old Contrary's footplate, in the yard]

Flat floor stands for the engine. The departure control is here, and the mail car behind. Use the current controls to continue.

[Greybox: Sawtooth Cut]

The footplate as it stands at the lanterns, with the regulator and the reverser. Ahead: the spread rail and Preacher Dole. The tabernacle siding is beyond him.

[Greybox: the boxcar tabernacle]

Dole's chapel on a dead siding: a hymnal, a collection plate, and a boiler somebody has chalked.

[Greybox: the valley platform]

Where the Night Mail arrives if she gets through.

[Sawtooth Cut]

Lanterns across the track. The left-hand rail is spread, not gone.

[Mail car]

The payroll and the valley's fever medicine, aboard the Night Mail.

[Mail car]

The payroll and the fever medicine, delivered.

[Mail car]

The payroll and the fever medicine, locked in the yard. Not delivered.

[Mail car]

Empty. The payroll and the fever medicine were taken up the hill.

[Old Contrary]

At the valley platform, sound.

[Old Contrary]

At the valley platform, bent and scorched from the gap.

[Dispatch board]

Every car is passed and stamped in the name of R. Ostrander, Inspector of Way. All stock is dispatched.

[Dispatch board]

Entries countersigned A. Lockridge. Suspect stock is held from dispatch.

[Dispatch board]

Closed by order of the sheriff of Mercy Crossing. No car is dispatched and nobody signs.

[Held stock]

Cars held from dispatch until they are inspected.

[Rail report]

The payroll and the fever medicine reached the valley.

[Rail report]

The payroll and the fever medicine are locked in the yard at Iron Junction, undelivered.

[Rail report]

The payroll and the fever medicine were taken from the train by the Black Rail.

[Rail report]

The payroll and the fever medicine are still aboard the Night Mail in Sawtooth Cut.

[Rail report]

The Night Mail ran the spread rail. The engine is damaged.

[Rail report]

You killed Preacher Dole in the Cut. His death does not erase the yard's inspection records.

[Rail report]

Preacher Dole is dead. His death does not erase the yard's inspection records.

[Rail report]

You accepted Dole's share. The payroll and medicine were taken from the train.

[Rail report]

The train returned with its cargo undelivered. The obstruction at Sawtooth Cut remains.

[Rail report]

You learned that square-marked silver pays for the pulled rails, and that Preacher Dole is Ostrander, Inspector of Way. Who pays is not known.

[Rail report]

You learned that square-marked silver pays for the pulled rails. Who pays is not known.

[Rail report]

You learned that Preacher Dole is Ostrander, Inspector of Way.

[Rail report]

You did not learn who Preacher Dole is or what he is paid in.

[Rail report]

Night Mail road complete. Greenwater remains playable; Red Hollow and the fair are not.

[Inspector's stamp]

You are carrying the stamp from Lockridge's drawer.

[Iron Junction story test]

Sheriff Pritchard has the inspector's stamp.

[Iron Junction story test]

The stamp was not seen to reach Sheriff Pritchard. It is not recorded delivered. Speak to him again.

[Iron Junction]

By the sheriff's order the dispatch board at Iron Junction is closed. Augusta Lockridge signs and dispatches nothing. The yard has no master. This is shown at the yard.

[Iron Junction]

Augusta Lockridge is dead. The dispatch board at Iron Junction is closed and nobody signs. The yard has no master. This is shown at the yard.

[Iron Junction story test]

Sheriff Pritchard has the stamp. The change at the yard could not be shown, so it is not recorded yet. Speak to him again, or use the dispatch board.

journal.text: Iron Junction is a roundhouse with a wall round it and a woman on the turntable who points her office at whoever is coming.
Gussie Lockridge has lost four trains in a month. Tonight's carries the payroll and the valley's fever medicine. She wants a gun on the footplate and is not asking twice.
journal.context: Lockridge's assignment delivered and acknowledged, Lockridge alive

journal.text: You agreed to ride the Night Mail with the payroll and fever medicine.
journal.context: NATIVE ONLY: the job taken on at the footplate with nobody to give it

journal.text: Old Contrary is under steam. Billie Tupper drives as if the dark owed her money.
journal.context: The departure confirmed with Billie alive and present to drive

journal.text: You boarded Old Contrary. The regulator is ready.
journal.context: NATIVE ONLY: the same without her

journal.text: Lanterns across the track. A rail pulled out of true. A tall man on a flatcar with a hymnal, and thirty rifles for a choir.
journal.context: Arrival in the Cut seen

journal.text: Billie put the regulator through the roof. Old Contrary took the gap in the air and came down on the rails, more or less.
journal.context: The run seen finished, Billie driving

journal.text: Preacher Dole is lying across the rail he pulled. His congregation went up the hill without singing.
journal.context: Dole dead by the player's hand in the unsettled encounter, the Black Rail seen out of it

journal.text: You sold the Night Mail. The payroll and the fever medicine went up the hill on the Black Rail's shoulders, and Billie Tupper was put off to walk home.
journal.context: The sale seen finished, Billie alive and released

journal.text: Billie backed her out of the Cut in the dark. The mail is safe and no use to anybody, and the line is shut.
journal.context: The reverse seen finished, Billie driving

journal.text: The Night Mail got through. The medicine and payroll arrived; the engine is damaged.
journal.context: NATIVE ONLY: the run with the player at the regulator

journal.text: Preacher Dole is dead. His death does not erase the yard's inspection records.
journal.context: NATIVE ONLY: Dole dead otherwise

journal.text: You accepted Dole's share. The payroll and medicine were taken from the train.
journal.context: NATIVE ONLY: the sale with no living Billie released

journal.text: The train returned with its cargo undelivered. The obstruction at Sawtooth Cut remains.
journal.context: NATIVE ONLY: the reverse without Billie driving

journal.text: The preacher's collection plate is full of silver slugs. Each is stamped with a small square mark.
journal.context: The collection plate inspected

journal.text: Dole described square-marked silver paying for pulled rails.
journal.context: NATIVE ONLY: Dole's admission delivered

journal.text: The name written in the front of the preacher's hymnal is R. Ostrander, Inspector of Way.
journal.context: The flyleaf read through

journal.text: Preacher Dole identified himself as Ostrander, Inspector of Way.
journal.context: NATIVE ONLY: Dole named himself

journal.text: The dead inspector's stamp is in Gussie Lockridge's drawer. The pad is still wet.
journal.context: The drawer opened

journal.text: You left the stamp where it was. The trains will run, and Ostrander will go on passing them.
journal.context: Keep stamping: Lockridge alive, the stamp in her drawer

journal.text: Lockridge countersigned the reviewed entries in her own name. Suspect stock is held from dispatch.
journal.context: The countersigning scene seen finished. The accepted log is not imported

journal.text: You took the stamp. Gussie Lockridge watched you carry it out and did not turn her office to follow.
journal.context: The stamp taken with a living Lockridge to watch. Custody, not delivery

journal.text: You took the inspector's stamp as evidence. It has not yet been delivered to Pritchard.
journal.context: NATIVE ONLY: the stamp taken without her
Left for Mercy with an outcome of the encounter recorded

objectives.text: Find the yardmaster at Iron Junction
Ride the footplate of the Night Mail
Get the Night Mail through Sawtooth Cut, or do not
(Optional) Find out who has been signing for a dead man
Take the mail through, or take the train back to the yard
Leave Iron Junction for Mercy Crossing
Bring the inspector's stamp to Sheriff Pritchard
